subject: POC workshop windows & load-rehearsal plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jia Lee <jia.lee@globalretailops.com>, Tomás Rivera <tomas@acmedata.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC workshop windows & load-rehearsal plan

Hi Jia / Tomás —

Thanks again for kicking off the POC with us. To keep things tight and usable for your engineers across regions, we propose a three-day hands-on workshop series plus a dedicated load-rehearsal:

Plan (proposed):
- Day 1 (US-friendly): prompt review, routing config, integrations walkthrough
  - Window A: 16:00-18:00 PST (UTC-8) / 23:00-01:00 UTC
- Day 2 (EU-friendly): deep prompt tuning, KV cache walkthrough, small-scale load runs
  - Window B: 10:00-12:00 GMT (UTC+0) / 02:00-04:00 PST
- Day 3 (APAC-friendly): large-scale routing tests, quantization checks, full load rehearsal
  - Window C: 09:00-11:00 SGT (UTC+8) / 01:00-03:00 UTC
- Load rehearsal: last session of Day 3: a stepped ramp to target concurrency with synthetic traffic (we describe specifics in the attached load-plan.xlsx).

We're aiming for rotating start times so your regional teams can join the day that fits their local hours. Attached: poc-agenda-v1.pdf and load-plan.xlsx; also added a provisional .ics (regional-availability.ics) with the three candidate slots.

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm whether the three windows above are acceptable on your side, or tell us which of the three you prefer for each regional team.
2) Share any blackout dates (end-of-year freezes / holiday coverage) — we can shift into Jan if needed.
3) For the load rehearsal: do you want Redwood to drive the synthetic load (recommended) or provide credentials so you can run tests from your infra?

If you prefer, we can split each day into 90-minute regional blocks and record the sessions.

I'll loop in engineering (Dev, Rishi, Karthik) to propose a final rotating cadence once you confirm availability.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: poc-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda stub), load-plan.xlsx (test matrix), regional-availability.ics

To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC workshop windows & load-rehearsal plan

Monica —

Thanks for the clear plan. We like the three-day structure. A few quick notes from our side:
- APAC on Day 3: can we move Window C earlier by one hour (07:30-09:30 SGT) instead of 09:00-11:00? Our Singapore infra team has a noon cutoff for maintenance windows.
- For the load rehearsal, we prefer Redwood to run the synthetic traffic so we can observe only (less risk on our infra).
- Blackout: Dec 23–27 our teams are out; Jan slots are OK if you need to push.

If you can send a revised .ics with the adjusted APAC time, we'll confirm internal attendees.

Thanks — Jia
Jia Lee
Head of Platform Integrations | GlobalRetailOps
jia.lee@globalretailops.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC workshop windows & load-rehearsal plan

Thanks Jia — noted and happy to run the synthetic load.

Updated proposal (short):
- Day 1 (US): 16:00-17:30 PST — prompt review + routing and quick smoke runs.
- Day 2 (EU): 10:00-11:30 GMT — prompt tuning + KV cache deep-dive + 30-min steady 50-concurrency run.
- Day 3 (APAC): 07:30-09:30 SGT (moved earlier per Jia) — routing failovers, model-variant fallback, and the full load rehearsal.

Load rehearsal plan summary (see load-plan.xlsx for matrix):
- 0–10 min: warmup at 5 concurrent sessions
- 10–30 min: ramp to 50 concurrent sessions (steady)
- 30–60 min: stepped ramp to 200 concurrent sessions (observability + latency SLIs measured)
- Final 15 min: cool down and log collection

We will:
- Provision a dedicated test model variant (quantized-medium) for the rehearsal to keep costs manageable.
- Stream logs to the shared S3 bucket and post a short CSV with latency percentiles to Confluence.

Attachment: updated-availability.ics (I attached a quick .ics with Jia's APAC tweak).

/dev
Dev Patel
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final schedule + invites (POC workshops & load rehearsal)

Great — thanks for the quick replies. Finalized schedule is below and I just sent calendar invites (see related link). Please review and accept the one that corresponds to your region.

Final schedule (local times):
- Day 1 (US focus) — Mon, Jan 11, 2027 — 16:00–17:30 PST (Monica, Dev, Rishi)
- Day 2 (EU focus) — Wed, Jan 13, 2027 — 10:00–11:30 GMT (Karthik, Hannah)
- Day 3 (APAC focus + load rehearsal) — Fri, Jan 15, 2027 — 07:30–09:30 SGT (Dev, Rishi, Lauren)

Logistics / notes:
- Redwood will drive the synthetic load for the rehearsal. We will share test credentials 48 hours before Day 3 for any pre-tests you want to run.
- Please grant read-only access to the logs bucket to the email list in the invite; we will upload latency percentiles + trace IDs immediately after the run.
- If you'd like a separate canary rehearsal (10-min smoke) earlier in Week of Jan 4, we can add a 30-min slot — reply if that helps.

Attachments: regional-availability.ics (updated). Calendar invites: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-poc-20261215

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Monica
